name: vibe-coding-library
description: Engineering playbooks for any MCP coding agent: find a method, load its current prompt and follow its verification workflow.

interface.longDescription: Vibe Coding Library supplies engineering methods to any coding agent supporting MCP over Streamable HTTP. Search from a bug, implementation goal, planning task, patch review or verification need without knowing a workflow name. The two read-only tools find among 241 workflow entries and load the current prompt, domain instructions and a conditional execution outline. Follow evidence handoffs through repair, relevant verification and repeated Patch Checking; later prompt bodies load only when reached. Search supports English, Spanish, Russian and Simplified Chinese; technical instructions are English. No publisher account or API key is required. Your agent uses its own project tools, rules and permissions; the service does not inspect or modify your repository.
defaultPrompt: Fix stale cache after a write using the relevant engineering workflow.
Review this patch and verify the resulting change.
Verify MCP tool discovery and authorization.

publication.release_notes: Vibe Coding Library 1.6.0 revises every skill and prompt workflow, adds explicit audit/repair/check handoffs and bounded repeated Patch Checking, and improves task-driven MCP discovery for any compatible coding agent. Search adds natural technical goals, exact-name aliases, multilingual concepts, individual purposes and match reasons. Retrieval exposes a conditional step outline and context reuse while preserving the two tool names and all 241 IDs. Instructions and client packages now share version 1.6.0. The website presents universal MCP connection alongside Codex and Claude examples.

es-ES.subtitle: Flujos de código bajo demanda
es-ES.description: Métodos de ingeniería para cualquier agente de código con MCP por Streamable HTTP. Busca entre 241 entradas por objetivo o síntoma y carga el paso actual, sus instrucciones y una secuencia condicional de reparación y verificación. Búsqueda en inglés, español, ruso y chino simplificado; instrucciones técnicas en inglés. Herramientas de solo lectura, sin cuenta ni clave API del editor.

ru-RU.subtitle: Сценарии разработки по запросу
ru-RU.description: Инженерные workflow для кодинговых агентов с MCP через Streamable HTTP. Поиск среди 241 сценария по задаче или симптому и загрузка текущего промпта с инструкциями и условной цепочкой исправления и проверок. Поиск на английском, испанском, русском и упрощённом китайском; технические инструкции на английском. Два тула работают только на чтение, аккаунт и API-ключ издателя не нужны.

zh-CN.subtitle: 按需加载开发工作流
zh-CN.description: 适用于支持 MCP Streamable HTTP 的编码代理。根据任务目标或故障症状搜索 241 个工程入口，加载当前提示、领域说明及带条件的修复与验证步骤。搜索支持英语、西班牙语、俄语和简体中文，技术说明为英语。两个工具仅提供只读指导，无需发布者账户或 API 密钥。
